seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Crane ring A1/A2 y-+6 carrying on-beam blocks + push chain, cancelled if a block leaves the colour-4 field.
A4/A3 beam w+-6 (max to field right): hooked next/collected at tip-4 drags on-beam blocks, else extension pushes swept blocks; blocked group -> beam alone.
Tags: hooked next with other on-beam blocks collected -> collected, next = first todo by legend x; unhooked off-beam collected reverts. Legend centre 2x2 = 0 while collected.
Clicks are full no-ops. Render: erase before objects with bg (4 field / rail 2 iff (y-top-2)%6<2 else 3 / 5), draw by layer, beam 2 iff (i+j)%3==1.
Hidden: HUD bar 3s = (n-1)//3, n = non-click actions, carried on frame continuity (fallback 3*bars+1 or 0); stateless 32/45 confirms only the bar phase is hidden.
